facts.fact: 2015 年，塞文山区的一通电话打断了在山中隐居写作的 Catherine Irène Bonnet
facts.anchor: IN 2015, IN THE Cévennes mountains, the telephone rang.

facts.fact: 来电者是 Christian de Monbrison（Élisabeth 的侄孙、兄长 Robert 之孙），自称 Catherine 的叔伯长辈，1942 年 9 月曾在 Le Chambon-sur-Lignon 的 Les Ombrages 藏身
facts.anchor: I am Christian de Monbrison. I am your great-uncle.

facts.fact: Christian 请 Catherine 参与对国家的法律索赔，追讨 1942 年 Élisabeth 位于 Neuilly-sur-Seine 的住宅被强制出售的款项
facts.anchor: He asked Catherine to take part in a legal claim to the state to recover the proceeds from the 1942 forced sale of Élisabeth’s house in Neuilly-sur-Seine.

facts.fact: 1944 年 3 月 Élisabeth 从 Drancy 送出最后一则口信，五天后 69 岁的她被押上 Convoy 70，再未回来
facts.anchor: Five days later she was forced onto Convoy 70 at age sixty-nine and never returned.

facts.fact: 1951 年 10 月 19 日法国法院驳回 Philippe de Forceville 的诉讼：文件不合，Élisabeth 在法律上不被认定为犹太人
facts.anchor: But in the hearing on October 19, 1951, the court said no—because the paperwork wasn’t right.

facts.fact: 2016 年 18 名后人（含 Christian 与 Irène 的三个曾孙女）向 CIVS 递交正式索赔，材料为 267 份脆旧文件
facts.anchor: In 2016, eighteen descendants, including Christian and Irène’s three great-granddaughters, filed a formal claim.

facts.fact: 2019 年索赔胜诉，最终赔偿 572,600 欧元（约 726,000 美元），Élisabeth 之孙 Jean-Claude de Forceville 得其中一半
facts.anchor: Not until 2019, seventy-five years after Élisabeth scribbled a will in Drancy, did they finally triumph. The final compensation: 572,600 euros.

facts.fact: 章末：时间没有赦免一切，但让 Christian、Catherine、Marion 以见证人而非受害者的身份，为 Irène、Élisabeth 与家族中名字被抹去的人寻求清算
facts.anchor: It allowed Christian and Catherine and Marion to seek a reckoning—not as victims, but as witnesses for Irène and Élisabeth, and all the others in their family with half-remembered names. They are no longer erased.
